description: CaNaBi₂Nb₃O₁₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4mm space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two BiO sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction and two NaCaNb₃O₁₀ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. In each BiO sheet, there are two inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Bi-O bond lengths are 2.32 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Bi-O bond lengths are 2.32 Å. O is bonded to four Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OBi₄ tetrahedra. In each NaCaNb₃O₁₀ sheet, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.64 Å) and four longer (2.81 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ca is bonded to twelve O atoms to form CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with four equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.71-2.80 Å. There are three inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with five NbO₆ octahedra and faces with four equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.12 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-12°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.27 Å. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with four equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-13°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.11 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Ca and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Nb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Nb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Ca and two Nb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OCa₄Nb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-1°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Na and two Nb atoms to form distorted ONa₄Nb₂ octahedra that share corners with five OCa₄Nb₂ octahedra and edges with four equivalent ONa₄Nb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-12°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Ca and two equivalent Nb atoms.
